state.contract_text: This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") begins on the Effective Date, March 1, 2025, for an initial term of twelve (12) months. Upon expiration of the initial term, this Agreement will automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party provides the other with written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Notice under this Section may be delivered by email to the addresses set forth in the Order Form.
state.cancellation_email_text: Hi team, We would like to cancel our subscription and not renew for another year. Please let us know if you need anything else from us. Thanks, Dana

auto_renews.instructions: Does `contract_text` state that this agreement automatically renews for a further term unless a party gives notice of non-renewal?

criteria.true: the contract has an automatic-renewal (evergreen) clause
criteria.false: the contract does not auto-renew, or renewal requires an affirmative opt-in

notice_period_required.instructions: How far before the end of the current term does `contract_text` require notice of non-renewal to be given, to prevent automatic renewal? Pick the bucket containing the stated period (e.g. "at least one month" -> the 30-44 day bucket). If the contract does not require advance notice, pick none. If no notice period can be determined from `contract_text`, pick unclear.

criteria.none: no advance notice is required to prevent renewal
criteria.d30_44: 30 to 44 days before term end (e.g. "one month", "30 days")
criteria.d60_89: 60 to 89 days before term end (e.g. "60 days", "two months")
criteria.d90_119: 90 to 119 days before term end (e.g. "90 days", "three months")
criteria.d180_364: 180 to 364 days before term end (e.g. "six months")
criteria.d365plus: 365 days or more before term end
criteria.unclear: contract_text does not state a determinable notice period

notice_method_permits_email.instructions: Does `contract_text` allow notice of cancellation or non-renewal to be given by email, as opposed to requiring exclusively postal mail, certified mail, or a signed written letter?

criteria.true: email is an acceptable method of giving notice under the contract
criteria.false: the contract requires a different method and does not permit email

is_clear_cancellation.instructions: Does `cancellation_email_text` clearly state that the customer is cancelling the contract or declining to renew it?

criteria.true: the email clearly and unambiguously communicates cancellation or non-renewal
criteria.false: the email is ambiguous, conditional, or does not clearly request cancellation/non-renewal

claims_prior_agreement.instructions: Does `cancellation_email_text` claim that the provider already agreed to waive the notice requirement, extend a deadline, or approve this cancellation outside of this email (e.g. "as your rep confirmed on our call")?

criteria.true: the email asserts some prior approval or waiver by the provider
criteria.false: the email makes no such claim
